question.prompt: The first AMC \(8\) was given in \(1985\) and it has been given annually since that time. Samantha turned \(12\) years old the year that she took the seventh AMC \(8.\) In what year was Samantha born?

solutions.explanation:
The first contest is already counted in \(1985\), so reaching the seventh contest requires only \(7-1=6\) one-year gaps. The seventh AMC \(8\) was therefore held in \(1985+6=1991\).

Samantha turned \(12\) that year, so her birth year was
\[
1991-12=1979.
\]
The answer is \(1979\), choice \(\mathrm{A}\).
solutions.title: Count the gaps between contests
